athlete_notes.arrival_status: Home safely after PCP and driving coaching.
athlete_notes.lap_1: Jumps are OK and rhythm for scrubs is almost coming back. Small bike-length tabletops allow boost and squash. Scrub is not smooth yet because confidence is limited at high entry speed.
athlete_notes.lap_2: Loop with switchbacks used to get rhythm on berm corners.
athlete_notes.lap_3_5_7: Trail 16 flow DH line with jumps. Not squashing, but riding smooth. Corners are almost back to race pace.
athlete_notes.driver_coaching_context: Mild cognitive stress in an air-conditioned car, not a major physical load.

coach_notes.technical_read: Cornering rhythm is returning faster than high-speed jump/scrub confidence. Keep PCP progression focused on entry-speed confidence and smooth squash timing, not bigger features.
coach_notes.next_pcp_focus: Separate jump-shape practice from race-pace cornering. Use the small tabletops for boost/squash timing at controlled speed, then Trail 16 for smooth corner pace without adding scrub demands.
coach_notes.recovery_priority: Evening readiness is red with Body Battery 6 and a 7-day load spike; no further training before Sunday Sabbath rest.
